fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: snook just inside the passes; beach mixed bag of reds, snook, pompano, whiting, black drum; pompano in the pass. LEMON BAY: smaller black drum and big reds under docks; trout and juvenile gags on flats; Bull/Turtle Bay reds and snook. NEARSHORE: reefs little stuff plus a few snook; mangrove/lane/yellowtail from ~80 ft; red grouper to 26 in at 100–150 ft; permit/African pompano on wrecks. Baits: live shrimp, white bait/pinfish, cut ladyfish, soft plastics.
redtide: FWC Sep 25: K. brevis background in SWFL (Charlotte/Lee and offshore Monroe); no fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 2.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD (Healthy Beaches; Manasota Key enterococci 10 on 9/21; gulf beaches Good).
fpl: Charlotte ~2 / Sarasota ~148 FPL customers out (evening 9/26 tracker).
